label: DevOps Engineer
expertise: DevOps; AWS/Azure/GCP; Docker; CI/CD pipelines; Infrastructure automation; Linux systems; Monitoring; Database administration

statement.headline: I keep the pipelines green and the infrastructure boring.
statement.sub: CI/CD, cloud migrations, and on-call ownership. AWS and Azure deployments that ship every day without drama.

Duke Energy.summary: Refactored weather-forecasting dashboard deployment to AWS. Migrated authentication infrastructure to Azure AD from user/password. Configured containerized deployments and cron-based automation.

OptumRX Health / Red Ventures.summary: Built automation pipelines for E-commerce platform. Configured CI/CD, deployment workflows, and infrastructure for production systems.

Swell Energy.summary: Managed infrastructure for solar grid management platform. Docker containerization, PostgreSQL database administration, Django backend deployment.

Viasat.summary: Managed deployment and on-call for in-flight entertainment portals serving dozens of airlines. Jenkins CI/CD, AWS infrastructure, MySQL database management.

Twilio Inc..position: Senior Web Engineer - DevOps & Brand Team
Twilio Inc..summary: Managed infrastructure for twilio.com and all sub-sites. Implemented testing pipelines, migrated blog and legal sites to Laravel CMS. Worked emergency on-call. Docker deployments, WordPress and Django infrastructure.

Invitae.summary: Managed database health, configured continuous integration instances, web-hooks, bi-weekly deployments. Created an automated Selenium testing workflow.

10up.summary: Managed deployment pipelines and infrastructure for client websites including Microsoft, Uber, AARP.

Lumenai (Startup).summary: Built CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Automated deployments with Docker and Jest testing. The company saw a 15% rise in productivity and experienced 35% growth in 6 months.

Appalachian State University.summary: Managed database and handled deployments for campus web infrastructure. Created custom CMS framework used by all campus web pages.
